description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2024: Evaluating the Impacts of Flooding on Transportation Infrastructure in Coastal Areas is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Cristian Varela, University of Rhode Island (uri.edu). The project is focused on understanding and mitigating the impact of urban floods on transportation infrastructure in Atlantic City, New Jersey. It involves estimating inundation depths, analyzing how floods affect traffic flow, vehicle speeds, traffic flow capacity, and congestion by simulating a storm surge affected evacuation. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-6b5q-4w86. Keywords: NSF NHERI SimCenter, Transportation Infrastructure, Urban Flooding, Disaster Resilience. Published 2024-08-19. Facility named: SimCenter. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
